questions: The DateTime format must become a placed value named through one of the three permitted paths, such as an imported provider constant, instead of requiring the generator to guess it from the EXIF standard.

topics.topic: Whether source_id must exclude path separators to guarantee a three-segment reference
questions: Either constrain or validate source_id so it cannot contain path separators, or remove the requirement that the resulting reference always has exactly three segments.

quotes: store_image: [PATH_OR_ARTIFACT_POLICY] MUST build the reference as a relative Portal file reference of three segments, the imported STORED_IMAGES_FOLDER constant, the canonical lowercase hyphenated project id and the source id followed by the imported STORED_IMAGE_SUFFIX constant, take its path from _store_path before anything is written, write content there with _atomic_write below the resolved binary_root of context with the imported STORED_IMAGE_MODE constant, the imported STORE_FOLDER_MODE constant for folders and durable_folder true, and return the reference; a DelivererError of _store_path and an OSError of the write MUST pass to the caller.
judgement.divergence: One implementer rejects a source_id containing a path separator before writing, while another accepts it and creates additional nested path segments; the caller notices refusal versus successful storage and a differently structured reference.
judgement.why: The note requires a three-segment reference but does not specify how separator-containing source_id values are handled, and this behavioral gap belongs to the later state that owns input behavior rather than keeping State 7 open.
